scope: Static source, fresh binding, and paired-lane control review only. This is not formal verification, acceptance, proof credit, or dispatch authorization.

details: Six exact-N2 swap fixtures replace from_fn with two independent ArbitraryValue calls; sort4 array constructors use four independent element generators.
B16 uses the unchanged raw u8 any_array override; source equality was checked at the pinned tool commits.
sort4_profile uses four thin destination targets equivalent to its former four-element frame.
merge4_profile is an exact-length leaf that calls the real bidirectional_merge body, has sorted-halves precondition and sorted/full-value posts; the len4 consumer stubs this exact target.
General merge_profile 2..=32 is unchanged. Runtime implementation, trait bounds, input domains, assumptions, and existing covers are unchanged; one new merge4 return cover is added.
reading_comparator is a shared stateless closure factory in both matching helper modules. arbitrary_less keeps both volatile reads and a fresh nondeterministic answer per invocation.

checks: fresh row/source hashes and original oracle retention across 62 rows plus the new merge4 leaf
exact target/profile/closure binding and rejection of function-item substitution
new leaf posts/covers and exact consumer stub dependency
bad/missing/unknown/unreachable postconditions and wrong/unsatisfied covers fail closed
relocated frame write site and negative oracle binding

polyiter.reason: The existing general-scratch path consumes the offset array; avoiding it would change the selected route or reduce the randomized control's branches, so no equivalent harness-only workaround preserves the row and oracle.

control_review.dispatch: PREPARATION_ONLY_NO_DISPATCH; one push runs serialized ON then OFF; OFF is configured to continue after ON failure.
control_review.caps: Each lane: 180-minute workflow cap, max_parallel=1, same 63-row manifest and per-row/setup/proof/output/RSS caps; aggregate serial wall cap 360 minutes.
control_review.test_only_delta: Final control continuation changes only test_workflow_repo.py and ON/OFF request hashes/path inventories; no workflow, runner, source, oracle, or cap change.

limitations: No CI, compiler, Rust, Kani, CBMC, or proof execution was performed.
Generated closure demangler spelling and generated frame variable binding remain NOT_RUN; fresh lane exports must bind them exactly or fail closed.
Static GO applies to packet preparation only. It does not make any row ACCEPTED or remove the two BLOCKED_TOOL statuses.
